title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-07
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > CDWAV > Cool Edit Pro Noise Filter > SHN > CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a classic ’69 show, highlighted by a scorching Hard to Handle, a powerful Dark Star jam and the iconic Other One → Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a great‑board source with vintage warmth and just enough audience bleed to convey the concert atmosphere. Musically the set shines – reviewers repeatedly point out an intense Hard to Handle, a soaring Good Lovin' jam, a memorable Dark Star (despite a brief cut), and the legendary Other One → Lovelight sequence featuring Keith “Pig” on organ. Overall the performance is considered classic Dead material, with only minor sloppiness noted in typical ’69 style.

ai_rating.rationale: 8 reviews overwhelmingly positive (7 × 5‑star, 1 × 4‑star, 1 × 3‑star) with consistent praise for both the music and the soundboard quality; only minor criticisms of sloppiness and a cut in Dark Star.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and warm vintage soundboard mix with some audience bleed; praised as "great board" and "sound quality is great considering the vintage". Minor issues noted: a painful cut in Dark Star and typical ’69‑style sloppiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a strong second disc that flows well, with seamless transitions into extended jams; the Other One → Lovelight sequence is described as a high point.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Improvisational riff in Dark Star noted as a precursor to later Slipknot motif.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith "Pig" on organ praised on Both Other One and Lovelight; keyboards add wailing texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums described as wailing and driving the high energy of the set.
